neighboring_unit_entries.title: Reducing the GUE identification to a subset identity
neighboring_unit_entries.why_material: The Möbius side factors into subset functions X_S, the determinant Fourier transform factors into cycle-overlap functions Y_S, and equality reduces to a local identity for every zero-sum subset under the support bound.

neighboring_unit_entries.title: Spitzer random-walk identity closes the arithmetic-to-GUE bridge
neighboring_unit_entries.why_material: Cycle overlap is reinterpreted as one minus the range of a zero-sum walk; Spitzer's unique rotation below a chord and upper-convex-envelope decomposition count that range by set partitions, proving the subset identity needed for the GUE determinant.

related_synthesis_entries.claim: Smoothing and Fourier localization turn zeros into bounded prime products; discreteness forces multiplicative diagonals, universal second moments reduce them to pairings, and Möbius/cycle combinatorics identifies those pairings with the GUE determinant.
related_synthesis_entries.limit: The chain is proved only under the source's coefficient and Fourier-support hypotheses, and the unsmoothed statement additionally uses RH.
